trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: يَا مَنْ كَانَ وَيَكُوْنُ وَلَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهٖ شَيْءٌ يَا مَنْ لَا يَمُوْتُ وَلَا يَبْقٰى اِلَّا وَجْهُهُ الْجَبَّارُ يَا مَنْ يُّسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهٖ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيْفَتِهٖ يَا مِنْ اِذَا دُعِيْ اَجَابَ وَيَا مَنْ اِذَا اسْتُرْحِمَ رَحِمَ وَيَا مَنْ لَا يُدْرِكُ الْوَاصِفُوْنَ صِفَتَهٗ مِنْ عَظَمَتِهٖ يَا مَنْ لَّا تُدْرِكُهُ الْاَبْصَارُ وَهُوَ يُدْرِكُ الْاَبْصَارَ وَهُوَ اللَّطِيْفُ الْخَبِيْرُ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA MAN KAANA WA YAKOO-NO WA LAIY-SA KAMIS-LEHI SHAIY-OON YAA MAN LAA YAMOO-TO WA LAA YABQAA ILLAA WAJHO-HUL JABBAA-RO YAA MAIY-YO-SABBE-HUR RA’DO BE-HAMDE-HI WAL MALAA-E-KATO MIN KHAIY-FATE-HI YAA MIN IZAA DO-E’E AJAA-BA WA YAA MAN EE-ZAS TUR-HEMA WA YAA MAN LAA YUDRE-KUL WAASE-FOONA SEFA-TA-HU MIN A’Z-MATE-HI YAA MAL-LAA TUDRE KOHUL AB-SAARO WA HOWA YUDRE-KUL AB-SAARA WA HOWAL LATEE-FUL KHABEE-RO.

trans.en: O He who exists and existed and there is none like Him. O He who shall not perish and none shall survive but Your Irresistible Face. O He for whom „thunder repeateth His praises, and so do the angels, with awe: O He who answers whenever called! O He who has Mercy when asked for! O He whose attribute of Grandeur those who extol cannot comprehend! O He Whom no vision comprehends, but He Comprehends all vision. And He is the Knower of Subtleties, the All-Aware.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: يَا مَنْ يَّرٰى وَلَا يُرٰى وَهُوَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ الْاَعْلٰى يَا مَنْ لَا يُعِزُّهٗ شَيْءٍ وَلَا يَفُوْتُهٗ اَحَدٌ يَا مَنْ بِيَدِهٖ نَوَاصِي الْعِبَادِ اَسْئَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْكَ وَبِحَقِّكَ عَلٰى مُحَمِّدٍ اَنْ تُصَلِّي عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَاَنْ تَرْحَمَ مُحَمَّدًا وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ وَتَرَحَّمْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَ وَآلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ فِي الْعَالَمِيْنَ اِنَّكَ حَمِيْدٌ مَّجِيْدٌ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA MAIY YARAA WA LAA YURAA WA HOWA BIL-MANZA-RIL A’LAA YAA MAN LAA YO-I’ZZO-HU SHAIY-IN WA LAA YAFOO-TOHU AHA-DOON YAA MAN BE-YADE-HI NAWAA-SIL E’BAADE AS-ALOKA BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIN A’LAIY-KA WA BE-HAQQE-KA A’LAA MOHAMMADIN AN TO-SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN WA AN TAR-HAMA MOHAMMADAN WA AALE MOHAMMADIN KAMAA SAL-LAIY-TA WA BAARAK-TA WA TARAH-HAMTA A’LAA IBRAA-HEEMA WA AALE IBRAA-HEEMA FIL A’A-LAMEENA INNA-KA HAMEE-DOON MAJEE-DOON.

trans.en: O He who sees everything but nothing sees You. O He who is in the heavenly heights! O He other than whom nothing is more exalted and above whom there is no one! O He who controls all the affairs of the creatures! I ask You for the right which Muhammad (s.a.w.a) has incumbent upon You, and for Your Right incumbent upon Muhammad (s.a.w.a). Please bestow Your Blessings on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) and bestow Your Mercy on Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his Progeny (a.s) as You bestowed Your Blessings, Blessedness and Mercy on Abraham and his Progeny (a.s) in both worlds as You are Praiseworthy, and Glorious!

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
